head: cloud/check-pr-title-test
title: test(ci): cover the pull request title check
body:
`tools/ci/check-pr-title.py` gates every pull request title (`.github/workflows/pr-title.yml`), but nothing tested it. This PR adds `tests/tools/check_pr_title_test.py`, registered as `check_pr_title_test` (labels `cpu;docs`) and added to the hosted `check-pr` list in `cmake/Checks.cmake`.

The test covers:
- The examples in `docs/RELEASING.md`, which must pass.
- `TYPES` equals the type table in `docs/RELEASING.md`, so the check and the release policy cannot drift apart. Every documented type passes.
- Invalid titles: an empty title, a capitalized or unknown type, a missing or doubled space after the colon, an empty description, an empty, uppercase or punctuation-led scope, a space before the colon, `!` before the scope, a doubled `!`, and a merge-commit title.
- Multi-line titles (`\n`, `\r`, trailing newline), which get the single-line error.
- The `main()` exit status and PASS/FAIL output.

The checker itself is unchanged. To confirm the test would catch regressions, I mutated the checker and reran it. Each of these made it fail: a case-insensitive pattern, a scope allowed to start with punctuation, an empty description accepted, and `revert` dropped from `TYPES`.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending (test-only change; nothing to validate on hardware).

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope (x86-64 CPU host, Python 3.11, `cpu-test` preset):
- `python3 tests/tools/check_pr_title_test.py`: 5 tests OK.
- `cmake --build --preset pr` on this branch: 57/57 tests passed, including the new `check_pr_title_test`.
- `tools/ci/check-docs.py`: PASS.
- I did not run `nix build .#checks.x86_64-linux.pr`.
